system_scope.purpose: 생성, 목록, 삭제 엔드포인트를 갖춘 간단한 TODO REST API입니다.

features.name: Create Task
features.description: Allow users to create a new task with a title and optional description.

features.name: List Tasks
features.description: Retrieve a list of all tasks for the authenticated user.

features.name: Delete Task
features.description: Allow users to delete a specific task by its unique identifier.

features.name: Create TODO Item
features.description: Allow users to create a new TODO item through the API.

features.name: List TODO Items
features.description: Provide an endpoint to retrieve a list of all TODO items for a user.

features.name: Delete TODO Item
features.description: Allow users to delete a specific TODO item using its ID.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Implement user authentication to ensure that only authenticated users can create, list, or delete tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: The requirements imply that the API should be secure and user-specific, but no authentication feature is explicitly mentioned in the extracted features.

features.name: Update Task
features.description: Allow users to update an existing task's title and description.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: The requirement for a simple TODO REST API typically includes the ability to update tasks, which is not captured in the extracted features.

features.name: Error Handling for API Requests
features.description: Implement proper error handling for all API endpoints to ensure meaningful error messages are returned.

features.name: API Versioning
features.description: Implement versioning for the API to manage changes and maintain backward compatibility.

features.name: Task Status Management
features.description: Allow users to mark tasks as completed or pending.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: Managing the status of tasks is a common feature in TODO applications, which is not mentioned in the extracted features.
